description: Ratchet Codex hooks for session collection and skill generation

hooks.command: bash -lc 'RATCHET_DIR="${RATCHET_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}}"; uv run --directory "$RATCHET_DIR" python ratchet/client/codex_collector.py --event UserPromptSubmit'
bash -lc 'RATCHET_DIR="${RATCHET_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}}"; uv run --directory "$RATCHET_DIR" python ratchet/client/codex_collector.py --event Stop'
